data.description:
## Observed
record-review.sh is located at plugins/dso/scripts/record-review.sh but uses
HOOK_DIR based on its own directory (scripts/), then tries to source:
  scripts/lib/deps.sh (doesn't exist; actual: hooks/lib/deps.sh)
  scripts/lib/config-paths.sh (doesn't exist; actual: hooks/lib/config-paths.sh)
  scripts/lib/merge-state.sh (doesn't exist; actual: hooks/lib/merge-state.sh)
  scripts/compute-diff-hash.sh (doesn't exist; actual: hooks/compute-diff-hash.sh)

## Root cause
record-review.sh was designed to live in hooks/ (where all these files exist).
At some point it was moved to scripts/ without updating the relative paths.

## Fix
Either move record-review.sh back to hooks/, or update all paths to be
hooks-relative using CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT as the base.
data.title: record-review.sh in scripts/ has wrong relative paths (belongs in hooks/)
